##### Project general facts

Ryze Residences by AUM Development is a contemporary residential building designed for ambitious individuals, young professionals, creatives and forward-thinking investors. The architecture combines modern forms with natural elements through integrated greenery, glass facades and layered balconies that create depth and openness. The building rises above a ground floor and two podium levels to six residential floors and an amenity rooftop, offering a select collection of studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments.

Amenities are designed around movement, balance and connection. Residents enjoy a rooftop swimming pool with cabanas, a fully equipped gym, a lounge area, an outdoor party deck and a sky cinema under the open air. Common areas offer high-speed connectivity and an electric vehicle charging station, while round-the-clock security, lifts and covered parking add everyday comfort and peace of mind for residents and their guests throughout the year.

Interiors are carefully planned with smart layouts and durable finishes, creating spaces that function well and feel complete from the first day. Large windows and balconies bring in natural light, while efficient floor plans make the most of every square foot in studios and family apartments alike. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Warsan First is an established residential district in eastern Dubai, set beside International City and close to Dubai Silicon Oasis and Dubai Academic City. The area combines mid-rise apartment buildings with Dragon Mart, community retail, cafes, clinics and schools, and its calm, practical streets appeal to young professionals, students and families seeking accessible city living.

Ras Al Khor Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Awir Road connect residents with the wider city, and the International City metro station is close by. Dragon Mart and City Centre Mirdif are a short drive away, Dubai Festival City and Dubai Creek Harbour are nearby, and Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Warsan First is a freehold area open to international buyers and one of the more accessible entry points to the Dubai property market. Compact studios and one-bedroom homes with resort-style rooftop amenities attract tenants seeking value close to major employment hubs. Competitive prices, strong rental demand and improving infrastructure in eastern Dubai underpin attractive yields and long-term value for investors.
